emergence.summary: An autosomal-recessive neurometabolic disorder of monoamine-neurotransmitter synthesis. DDC encodes aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase (AADC), the enzyme that decarboxylates L-DOPA -> dopamine and 5-hydroxytryptophan -> serotonin, shared by the catecholamine and serotonin pathways. DDC loss-of-function collapses synthesis of dopamine, noradrenaline, adrenaline and serotonin -> the monoamine-neurotransmitter axis falls -> a severe infantile-onset disorder (developmental delay, truncal hypotonia with limb hypertonia, oculogyric crises, autonomic dysfunction, movement disorder). Read as enzyme LOF -> pathway throughput DOWN (substrate L-DOPA / 3-O-methyldopa accumulates while the products fail) -> axis DOWN: a DEFICIENCY-driven neurodevelopmental / neurodegeneration. The honest CONTRAST to Friedreich ataxia is the LEAD lever: in FRDA the approved lead is downstream-only (omaveloxolone, which does not restore frataxin), whereas HERE the approved lead is the SWITCH-LEVEL gene restore -- eladocagene exuparvovec, an AAV2 vector carrying the DDC gene delivered into the putamen, restores AADC enzyme and dopamine synthesis; it is FDA-approved (Kebilidi, Nov 2024 -- the first US gene therapy administered directly into the brain) and EMA-approved (Upstaza, 2022). So this is the gene-restore-IS-the-lead read (like RPE65 / LCA2's voretigene) on a neurometabolic axis -- the deficiency-driven neurodegeneration in which restoring the gene IS the approved lead, the precise complement to FRDA's downstream-only lead. Downstream / supportive agents -- pyridoxal-5'-phosphate / vitamin B6 (the AADC cofactor; helps cofactor-responsive residual-activity alleles but does NOT restore a null enzyme), dopamine agonists and MAO-B inhibitors -- are recorded as downstream-symptomatic, partial NON-switch management, not the lead. The gamma read is of the DDC promoter switch STRUCTURE; the disease lesions are coding/splice (e.g. the founder IVS6+4A>T splice allele common in East Asia; p.Gly102Ser), outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: monoamine-neurotransmitter synthesis throughput (dopamine / noradrenaline / adrenaline / serotonin) -- a neurotransmitter-biosynthesis axis; a deficiency-driven neurodegeneration

per_gene.note: DDC encodes aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase (AADC), the pyridoxal-5'-phosphate-dependent decarboxylase producing dopamine (from L-DOPA) and serotonin (from 5-HTP) -- the shared final enzyme of catecholamine and serotonin biosynthesis. LOF lowers throughput of BOTH monoamine pathways (substrate L-DOPA / 3-O-methyldopa accumulates; products fail) -> the neurotransmitter-synthesis axis falls (axis DOWN). 7p12.2 (OMIM 107930). NCBI official symbol DDC. Autosomal recessive. Coding/splice lesions (the East-Asian founder IVS6+4A>T splice allele; p.Gly102Ser); promoter firewall respected.
per_gene.src: Hyland 1992 (AADC deficiency identified); Brun 2010 Neurology 75:64 (clinical and biochemical spectrum of AADC deficiency)

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

levers.push_direction: deliver a working DDC copy to putaminal neurons -> restore AADC enzyme -> restore dopamine (and monoamine) synthesis -> raise the deficient axis toward normal (axis UP). The switch-level corrective: it restores the deficient gene itself, and here it is the APPROVED lead (the Friedreich-ataxia contrast, where the approved lead is downstream-only)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] restored-enzyme level / dopamine-synthesis recovery not derived from sequence
levers.src: Tai 2022 Mol Ther 30:509 (eladocagene exuparvovec long-term outcomes); Upstaza (EMA 2022) / Kebilidi (FDA Nov 2024) -- first US gene therapy administered directly into the brain, for AADC deficiency

levers.push_direction: supply the AADC cofactor (pyridoxal-5'-phosphate / vitamin B6) and downstream monoamine support (dopamine agonists, MAO-B inhibitors) -> partially raise monoamine tone in cofactor-responsive / residual-activity disease. DOWNSTREAM and symptomatic -- does NOT restore a null enzyme or correct the DDC switch
levers.agent_class: cofactor + downstream monoamine support (pyridoxal-5'-phosphate / B6; dopamine agonist; MAO-B inhibitor)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] downstream / partial compensation not derived from sequence; symptomatic, not the switch lever
levers.src: Brun 2010 / Wassenberg 2017 consensus guideline (supportive pharmacotherapy in AADC deficiency)

falsifiers.claim: DDC (AADC) loss lowers dopamine / serotonin synthesis throughput (axis DOWN)
falsifiers.falsifier: a DDC LOF genotype that RAISED CSF dopamine / serotonin end-metabolites (HVA / 5-HIAA), or AADC restoration that LOWERED them, refutes the deficiency (axis-DOWN) direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: CSF homovanillic acid (HVA), 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid (5-HIAA) and 3-O-methyldopa, with plasma AADC enzyme activity, stratified by DDC genotype

falsifiers.claim: restoring the deficient DDC gene is the SWITCH-LEVEL corrective and is the lead (unlike FRDA's downstream-only lead)
falsifiers.falsifier: if putaminal AAV-DDC re-expression failed to raise dopamine synthesis or improve motor milestones, the replace-DDC lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: dopamine-synthesis (F-DOPA) PET, CSF HVA, and gross-motor-milestone change after AAV2-hAADC (the eladocagene-exuparvovec trial design)
